correctness.rationale: Conditioning on independent X innovations gives EX_n²/(2h)=1+Σ_{k=0}^{n−2}<g,K_ρ^k g> for g(z)=|1−(c/J)·||z||²|. Mehler P_ρ is positive self-adjoint on Hermite chaoses, so K_ρ=M_g P_ρ M_g is positive Hilbert–Schmidt and positivity-improving for ρ<1; its simple top eigenfunction overlaps g. Thus bounded moments iff Λ_J(c,ρ)<1, with linear/exponential top-eigenvalue growth on/above 1. Hermite coefficients prove strict monotonicity for 0≤ρ1<ρ2<1: equality would require gu constant, impossible since 1/g is non-L² near its zero sphere. Gaussian operator continuity, Λ(0)=1−2c+(1+2/J)c², and ρ↑1 test functions supported at large ||z|| prove unique frontier for 0<c<2J/(J+2). Independent exact Wick/Hermite check recovers 25/24 Rayleigh witness for J=1,c=1/2,ρ=1/2.
